events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We reviewed your fare dispute and the fare stands — no refund is due.

The fare was based on the metered distance and time, and the trip you took was actually a little shorter than the fastest usual route (8.8 km versus 8.9 km), taking about 13 minutes rather than the 16 estimated. Your driver stayed on route, so nothing extra was added.

You don't need to do anything, and your account is unaffected.

DRIVER: We reviewed the fare dispute raised on this trip and found no problem with your fare. No adjustment was made against you.

The trip was measured at 8.8 km, slightly under the fastest usual route (8.9 km), and took about 13 minutes against a 16-minute estimate — no extra distance or time was billed. The trace showed you stayed on route throughout.

No action is needed from you and your account stands as normal.
